channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Students continue protests in Ranchi over alleged JPSC, JSSC exam irregularities, demand CBI probe
item.description: The protesters are demanding cancellation of the 14th JPSC Combined Preliminary Test held on April 19 and an independent probe by central agencies, including the CBI and Enforcement Directorate (ED), into alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations

item.title: 1.35 lakh affected still affected by floods in Assam; 3 more deaths take toll to 85
item.description: Sivasagar is the worst-hit district with over 55,000 people affected, followed by 40,000 people in Charaideo and 22,000 in Jorhat

item.title: M.K. Sanoo never saw continuous LDF rule as dangerous, says Pinarayi Vijayan
item.description: In what sounded like a veiled criticism of former Kerala Sahitya Akademi president K. Satchidanandan, Leader of the Opposition recalled how gracefully Sanoo had occupied the same position during an earlier tenure of the LDF

item.title: Slipper hurled at MP Pappu Yadav; Opposition slams police
item.description: U.P. resident detained; MP alleges conspiracy to kill him

item.title: Keep visiting Kolkata, your safety is my responsibility, West Bengal CM tells Taslima
item.description: Taslima Nasrin said that it was her dream to return to Kolkata and “history will remember those who shut the door on her and those who opened the door”

item.title: Eluru Collector urges citizens to share feedback on PGRS services through QR code
Heavy silt in Pazhassi dam disrupts drinking water treatment
item.description: High turbidity in the Pazhassi dam following intense rain and landslips disrupted drinking water treatment, reducing water supply to Kannur town and adjoining areas

item.title: Hunger strike against laterite quarry in Kannur suspended after Collector issues stop memo
item.description: District Collector issues temporary stop memo after inquiries into quarry permit following petitions by protest committee; residents allege quarry on ecologically sensitive laterite hill threatens around 50 Scheduled Tribe families and community facilities

item.title: Cauvery water from Kabini to reach Tamil Nadu soon
item.description: Owing to rain, Karnataka government began releasing Cauvery water from Kabini on Saturday

item.title: Former BJP MP Rebati Tripura steps back from politics, returns to teaching
item.description: The indigenous leader did not find a senior position in the recently restructured State committee of the BJP; he was one of few tribal leaders who helped the saffron party grow organisation in hills and interior tribal communities

item.title: Karnataka Cabinet expansion most likely on August 3
item.description: Sources said that competition is intense among Muslim legislators from Bengaluru that has turned out to be a stress point with elections to five corporations in Greater Bengaluru Authority region expected to be held shortly

item.title: Stand-up comedian Kunal Kamra shifts shows amid opposition from Hindutva outfits

item.title: Strong health systems for all with better public spending

item.title: Tamil Nadu government to expand cooperative lending under Singapengal Entrepreneurship Credit Scheme
item.description: T.N. Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has instructed officials to increase loans given under the scheme by 25%. Orders have also been issued to ensure at least 30% of loans across categories are extended to new members

item.title: Cauvery situation slightly better, says Karnataka CM

item.title: Taslima Nasrin calls for UCC across subcontinent, wants ban on madrasas

item.title: Tamil Nadu government drops use of ‘CM’s Thayumanavar Scheme’ in its official communications

item.title: T.N. farmers are cheated whenever Congress is in power in Karnataka: Nagenthran
item.description: Hitting back at TNCC chief’s remarks on the Cauvery water dispute, he asks Tagore to question his party’s government over not releasing water to T.N. despite a direction from the CWMA

item.title: BJP fears creative expression as it will strengthen ‘anti-establishment wave’, says Akhilesh
item.description: Accusing the BJP of misusing the talent of helpless and vulnerable artistes, the Opposition leader provides cash awards to two Ramlila artistes, adding, ‘there is no place for artistes in the BJP government’

item.title: Municipal Executive Officer beaten to death in Bihar; wife accuses LJP (RV) MLA of the murder
item.description: Vimal Kumar was on his way to Patna from Dehri-on-Sone in Rohtas district when he was attacked in a deserted area. The police have arrested his driver Mithilesh Kumar. Vimal’s wife has alleged that MLA Rajiv Ranjan Singh had repeatedly demanded ₹50 lakh from Vimal

item.title: Rahul Gandhi to PM: Students deserve an apology, not forgiveness

item.title: Pro-Channi slogans raised at Congress event in Barnala as infighting continues

item.title: Congress workers detained in Pune ahead of Shah, Doval visit
